scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic Markov-generator and derivative proof supplemented by a standalone exact-rational eight-state and four-state verifier; no independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite open three-spin, zero field, equal positive Ising bonds, rate-one local heat-bath flips, paired endpoint baths; finite positive temperatures. The sharp supremum is a zero-cold-temperature limiting value and not attained. Historical priority is not certified.
title: A sharp all-temperature heat-rectification bound for a homogeneous three-spin Ising chain
